metadata.question: Did the Central Valley of California have a higher water height equivalent in October 2022 than March 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need water height/storage data for Central Valley, California - Two time periods: October 2022 vs March 2023 - Best dataset: GRACE/GRACE-FO terrestrial water storage (lwe_thickness_jpl band = Liquid Water Equivalent thickness in cm) - Alternative: Surface water occurrence or JRC Water dataset (but these don't measure "height equivalent") 2. Masking strategy: - GRACE data is already processed, no cloud masking needed - Just need to extract mean water equivalent over the region 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: A legitimate measurement of 0 or low water storage (answer A or B based on comparison) - C1: No images in collection for either period - C2: After processing, no valid pixels (unlikely with GRACE as it's global coverage) - C3: Result is None/NaN or calculation fails - Compare Oct 2022 vs March 2023 values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Central Valley of California geometry (approximate bounds) const centralValley = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-122.5, 35.0], [-122.5, 40.5], [-119.0, 40.5], [-119.0, 35.0], [-122.5, 35.0]] ]); // 2. Define time periods const oct2022Start = '2022-10-01'; const oct2022End = '2022-10-31'; const march2023Start = '2023-03-01'; const march2023End = '2023-03-31'; // 3. Load GRACE-FO data (Liquid Water Equivalent thickness) const graceCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H') .select(['SWE_inst']); // Snow Water Equivalent + soil moisture // Try GRACE for better water storage const graceWater = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON_CRI') .select(['lwe_thickness']); // Get October 2022 data const oct2022 = graceWater .filterDate(oct2022Start, oct2022End) .filterBounds(centralValley); const oct2022Size = oct2022.size().getInfo(); console.log('Oct 2022 images:', oct2022Size); if (oct2022Size === 0) { console.log('No data for October 2022'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get March 2023 data const march2023 = graceWater .filterDate(march2023Start, march2023End) .filterBounds(centralValley); const march2023Size = march2023.size().getInfo(); console.log('March 2023 images:', march2023Size); if (march2023Size === 0) { console.log('No data for March 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean water equivalent for each period const oct2022Mean = oct2022.mean(); const march2023Mean = march2023.mean(); // Reduce to get average over Central Valley const oct2022Stats = oct2022Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: centralValley, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const march2023Stats = march2023Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: centralValley, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const oct2022Value = oct2022Stats.get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); const march2023Value = march2023Stats.get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); console.log('Oct 2022 water equivalent (cm):', oct2022Value); console.log('March 2023 water equivalent (cm):', march2023Value); // 5. Validation and answer if (oct2022Value === null || march2023Value === null || isNaN(oct2022Value) || isNaN(march2023Value)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare values if (oct2022Value > march2023Value) { console.log('October 2022 had higher water height equivalent'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('October 2022 did NOT have higher water height equivalent'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
